text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san, you're the one who left this on 
my desk, right!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: A birthday present for me... right? <username>!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing special. Just a heated eye 
mask.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm so happy! I'll start using it 
right away!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You're exaggerating... It's just something 
I use regularly.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
So you used it yourself and picked it as a 
gift because you liked it, Ayabe-san! 
Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hey... you're grinning way too much.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Because just knowing that you put so much 
thought into a present for me, Ayabe-san, 
makes me so happy!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You also knew that I've been watching a 
lot of race footage lately, didn't you? 
Fufufu, ehehehe.
